learning_outcomes.text: Define fundamental concepts and historical development of operations research.
Formulate linear programming models for real-world problems.
Solve linear programming problems using graphical and algebraic methods (Simplex and Big-M methods).
Conduct sensitivity analysis and interpret duality in linear programming.
Model and solve transportation problems using the transportation simplex method.
Develop network models and use appropriate algorithms to solve them.
Utilize software tools to solve linear programming and network models.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Operations Research, History, and Concepts
assessment_rules: The final success grade is determined by the contribution of in-term activities and the final exam. The Midterm Examination contributes 40% to the final grade. The Final Examination contributes 60% to the final grade.
bibliography: Hillier, F. S., & Lieberman, G. J. (2021). Introduction to Operations Research. McGraw-Hill Education.
Taha, H. A. (2017). Operations Research: An Introduction. Pearson.
Winston, W. L. (2004). Operations Research: Applications and Algorithms. Cengage Learning.
Lecture notes and supplementary materials provided during the course.
